name: Arthur Nicol
source:
Arthur is Lucia's younger brother whose hobbies include: gaming and visiting message boards on a regular basis. Due to his rather peculiar hobby, he is well-versed in the current happenings around the city, as well as the rumors that are starting to develop as a result from these strange occurrences.

Unlike most brother and sister relationships which are strongly resemblant of a cat-dog relationship, Arthur's relationship with Lucia is a tamed one, as they seem to be willing to cater to each other's needs.
